title: Incheon Airport check-in systems resume after 35 flights delayed
caption:
A major network disruption at Incheon Airport caused hours of delays for 13 airlines on Friday. Over 1,200 passengers were affected before manual check-in procedures helped clear the terminal.

Source: Koreaherald - Incheon Airport check-in systems resume after 35 flights delayed
